title: Research Engineer
description: Etihad AI: built ingestion and retrieval pipelines over Adobe and NICE data, extracted personas and planned journeys, integrated flight and return-journey APIs, and added real-time full-duplex voice via a streaming API.
Agent training: designed a UserLM simulator to emulate user behaviour for evaluation and stress-testing, and supported targeted supervised fine-tuning of the agent.
[AdvSim2Real](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08773): world-model-based training for web agents robust to adaptive prompt injection, in collaboration with Amazon. First author; submitted.
GROVE: benchmarked and trained LLM agents for persuasion. Equal contributor; submitted.
SIRA: self-improving recommendation agents that adapt to demand shifts through reinforcement learning. Second author; submitted.
PERSUADE: a debate arena for benchmarking, optimizing, and auditing persuasion in LLMs. First author; submitted.

[Noise Out, Bias In](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05894): closed-loop activation steering for targeted bias injection in diffusion language models, in collaboration with Cornell University. Equal contributor; submitted.
[Certification of Real Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05870): calibrated, diffusion-based content authentication with adversarial-robustness evaluation. First author; submitted.

title: Research Mentor, UGRIP — BraTS 2024
description: Mentored six UGRIP interns alongside three lab mentors under Dr. Mohammad Yaqub for the MICCAI BraTS 2024 challenge.
Enhanced the [MedNeXt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15872) baseline with Meta AI's schedule-free optimizer from “The Road Less Scheduled”.
Applied greedy and uniform model souping across 18 models trained with different hyperparameters.
Earned the UGRIP Best Team Award and third place in the BraTS 2024 SSA and Pediatrics tracks; presented the work at MICCAI 2024.
institution: BioMedIA, MBZUAI · Supervisor: Dr. Mohammad Yaqub

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Internship)
description: Built a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chatbot over Excel datasets, letting users ask natural-language questions and get answers grounded in business data.
Developed the retrieval and response workflows that surface relevant information and support interactive analysis of spreadsheet data.
Worked with stakeholders to translate reporting needs into chatbot functionality and analytical use cases.

title: Research Intern — Autonomous Last-Mile Vehicle
description: Developed a Drive-by-Wire system for an E-rickshaw, enhancing autonomous control capabilities.
Calibrated VLP-16 LiDAR and stereo cameras to improve sensor accuracy and reliability.
Utilized Commonroad Scenario Designer to create lanelet maps for IIIT Delhi OSM map and Carla open drive maps — [documentation](https://hackmd.io/9IH3-cV1T5it9JmIgcOSLw).
Implemented a PID controller for throttle and steering control of the E-rickshaw, ensuring smooth and responsive maneuvers.
Trained and deployed YOLOP for real-time object detection and perception tasks — [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MVEGYVS_Tus).

title: Research Intern — Linear Friction Actuation
description: Worked on Linear Friction Actuation to enhance mechanical system performance.
Designed an image-processing application to analyze photos of friction stir-processed material samples, extracting valuable data for research purposes.
Automated linear rails using a ball screw, stepper motor, Arduino Uno, and TB6600 motor driver for precise control of a welding torch.
institution: Jamia Millia Islamia · Supervisor: Dr. Arshad Noor Siddique
